mission: Release review for v0.4.0. Issue #14 (Fable-led self-enforcement audit) retired hooks/gdlc-instructions-loaded-check.sh — Claude Code discards InstructionsLoaded stdout and ignores its exit code, so the hook was a verified no-op; its dual-install nudge moved into gdlc-prompt-check.sh (UserPromptSubmit), _find-gdlc-root.sh gained CLAUDE_CODE_GDLC_WIZARD.md as a second anchor, and cli/init.js migrates ≤v0.3.0 installs (legacy hook file removal + settings sweep across ALL events, at nested-command granularity, force and non-force alike). Issue #15 synced the cross-model reviewer GPT-5.5 → GPT-5.6 Sol (fallback GPT-5.4 → Terra, xhigh kept, escalation paragraph added) in AI_SETUP_LANES.md + README, with contract tests. Test suite 115 → 126 assertions.
